accepted_main_papers_selected_read.title: MADE: Benchmark Environments for Closed-Loop Materials Discovery
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.license: PaperHTML explicitly CC BY4.0; official codeMIT independentlypinned by siblingdataagent
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.read_depth: Abstract;§3.1-3.5,§4.1-4.3, selected§B.1/B.4 andC.6 portions; not fullpaper/appendices
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.prior_capability: Sequential candidate proposal, oracle evaluation and feedback; modular and ReAct-style agent baselines already span generators, selectors, buffers and adaptive planning.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.evaluation_detail: Author experiments use orb-v3-conservative-inf-omat MLIP oracle, MACE-MP-0-medium selector; diversity/uniqueness and discovery-vs-budget metrics across systems.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.cost_and_replication: 5episodes/system;50oraclequeries;10systems each for3/4/5element spaces; paperreports oneT4perepisode. These aretheir design, not a mandated minimum or our measurements.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.implication: Direct required neighbor; a renamed generation-imputation-validation loop is insufficient increment. Use as environment when implementation/data roles allow; do not call MLIPoracle an independent wet or DFT confirmation.

accepted_main_papers_selected_read.title: Handling Missing Data with Graph Representation Learning
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.license: No redistributionlicense independentlyinspected; read/citeonly, no PDFcopy inoutputs
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.read_depth: Abstract/introduction;§3.1-3.2 andedge-dropout part§3;§4.1 experimental setup; selected officialreview excerpts, not fullappendix
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.prior_capability: Observed cells as bipartitegraph edges; missing-edge imputation, downstream label learning and edge-dropout masking already exist.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.evaluation_detail: Paper evaluates nine complete UCI tables with artificial missingness, with statistical and neural comparators.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.implication: A spiderweb analogy or masking/GNN imputer cannot be novelty alone. At minimum distinguish actual material-source missingness and chemical/state group transfer from artificiallymasked complete tables.

accepted_main_papers_selected_read.title: Flow Network based Generative Models for Non-Iterative Diverse Candidate Generation
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.prior_capability: Diverse positive-reward sampling and repeated generator→limited-oracle batch→surrogate-update learning are already explicit.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.evaluation_detail: §4.3 includes multi-round active learning and alternatives such as MCMC/PPO/VAE+BO/random.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.implication: Generating a diverse frontier and retraining onoracle feedback is established. A new hypercycle needs a distinct measurable mechanism and fair budgetmatched adaptive baseline.

accepted_main_papers_selected_read.title: Crystal Diffusion Variational Autoencoder for Periodic Material Generation
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.venue_verified: ICLR2022; officialDownloads2022 lists title and indexed finalPDF says publishedconference
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.license: arXivHTML perpetualnonexclusive; do not redistribute paper
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.prior_capability: Joint periodicmaterial representations, generative validity/diversity/propertyoptimization and physicallowerenergy gradient analogy already exist.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.evaluation_detail: Separates reconstruction, generation and propertyoptimization; empirical compositionvalidity is not quantumstability.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.implication: Do not equate a geometricvaliditycheck or independentGNN score with physical validation. Reusing a frozen generator is fine, but it does not establish a newgenerativealgorithm.

accepted_main_papers_selected_read.title: Disentangled Multi-Fidelity Deep Bayesian Active Learning
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.prior_capability: Multi-fidelity probabilistic activelearning and errors propagated from lower to higherfidelity representations already explicitly studied.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.evaluation_detail: Simulator costs based on timing; fixed initialization; highest-fidelity heldout nRMSE; activelearningcomparators andfidelity ablation.
accepted_main_papers_selected_read.implication: A cheap-versus-expensive validation scheduler and crossfidelity error isolation need directcomparison. Counting validatorcalls equally when costsdiffer is inadequate.
